benchmark.name: SPY/SGOV US Broad-Equity State Benchmark
benchmark.description: Point-in-time evidence records for measuring the current US broad-equity market-stress state. The portfolio illustration is downstream of, and does not define, the measurement target.

estimand.target_instrument: US broad equities represented by SPY
estimand.notes: SPY/SGOV portfolio weights and performance are not part of the ontology or estimand.

ontology.authority: This manifest is authoritative. Record files may use only the state values declared here and may not redefine their meaning.

states.definition: Evidence is collectively consistent with a constructive broad-equity environment, such as positive equity momentum and breadth, contained stress, or supportive credit conditions.
Evidence is conflicting, transitional, or insufficiently one-sided to support either the Risk-on or Risk-off state.
Evidence is collectively consistent with a defensive or stressed broad-equity environment, such as negative momentum or breadth, elevated volatility, or deteriorating credit conditions.

measurement_residual.purpose: Retains unexpressed or unresolved probability mass in the language-measurement channel; it is not a benchmark reference label.

partitions.test_access_policy: Do not use the test partition to define the ontology, choose prompts, fit calibration, or tune decision rules.

provenance.evidence_scope: Point-in-time summaries of broad-equity momentum, volatility, cross-equity breadth, credit conditions, and rates conditions.

rules: The CSV SHA-256 digest must match data.sha256.
Every reference_state must equal one ontology.states[].value.
Every partition must be declared in partitions.allowed_values.
target_name and evaluation_horizon must agree with the estimand.
All records used in point-in-time evaluation must have point_in_time_certified=true.
Observed row, partition, and class counts must match this manifest.
